title: Joby, Toyota form electric air taxi joint venture
summary: The new entity is part of the companies’ strategic alliance that has been in the works since 2024, which aims to support the certification and commercial production of Joby’s eVTOL aircraft.

title: World Cup drives record public transit ridership in US match cities
summary: Transit agencies in Atlanta, Los Angeles, Philadelphia and Seattle are reporting new highs in ridership on certain game days.

title: Judge rules against HUD’s ‘rapid, untimely overhaul’ of homeless funding
summary: Although the agency’s “hastily” made changes were deemed procedurally incorrect, the court denied a request to block anti-housing-first policy changes in the next round of Continuum of Care grants.

title: Will US high-speed rail projects ever leave the station?
summary: California’s San Francisco-Los Angeles project looks to the private sector for help, but other privately funded projects are struggling.

title: Discounted AI services coming to California cities, counties as state partners with Anthropic
summary: Local governments in California will receive a 50% discount on Claude, the company’s AI productivity assistant, Gov. Gavin Newsom announced.

title: Aging, mobility and resilience projects get $8.3M from AARP
summary: Fast-track projects ranging from safer streets and transit access to home-sharing and disaster preparedness were among those funded at a record level this year.

title: Hudson Tunnel funding restored by federal court
summary: Construction of the $16 billion project in New York and New Jersey can now continue. The Trump administration froze its funding, causing work to briefly stop in February.

title: How a changing US immigration landscape is impacting the housing crisis
summary: Housing demand is falling due to restrictive immigration policies, but the affordable housing shortage continues, says the Harvard Joint Center for Housing Studies.

title: Cities address root causes of health disparities
summary: A National League of Cities accelerator is helping local governments build cross-department solutions and design policies that distribute health benefits more evenly.

title: NYC prepares electric air taxi vertiports
summary: Existing heliports need charging infrastructure and additional electrical power to accommodate initial flights expected to begin later this year.
